newsitem.title: USA: Allegheny Power unit buys stake in station.
newsitem.headline: Allegheny Power unit buys stake in station.

text.p: Allegheny Power System Inc said Thursday that its unregulated subsidiary, AYP Energy, bought a 50 percent stake in a West Virginia power station for $170 million.
The company said the deal takes a step toward electric industry competition by buying half of the generating unit and then offering the power for sale on the open market.
The stake in the Fort Martin Power Station in Morgantown, W. Va., was purchased from Duquesne Light and Power Co, a subsidiary of DQE Inc.
The company said the deal puts AYP in the position to sell electricity and related services to power marketers, municipal electric systems and other utilities.
